chart.title:
Tipos de Negociação
Total:$QTDTOTAL
Realizado:$QTDATUAL
chart.expression: SELECT P.NUMERO AS QTDTOTAL, Q.QTD AS QTDATUAL, ROUND(CASE WHEN Q.QTD IS NULL OR Q.QTD = 0 THEN 0 ELSE Q.QTD * 100 / CASE WHEN P.NUMERO IS NULL OR P.NUMERO = 0 THEN Q.QTD ELSE P.NUMERO END END,0) AS PERCCOMPL FROM AD_PARAM P, (SELECT COUNT(1) AS QTD FROM TGFTPV TPV WHERE ATIVO= 'S' AND DHALTER = (SELECT MAX( DHALTER ) FROM TGFTPV T WHERE T.CODTIPVENDA = TPV.CODTIPVENDA)) Q WHERE P.CHAVE = 'QTDTIPVENDA'
